title: Conway's Topswops: total steps over all decks (a new exact sequence), and the Garden of Eden = A000255 (reproducible)
description: Exact statistics of J. H. Conway's Topswops process. A deck is a permutation of 1..n; one step reads the top card k and, unless k=1, reverses the top k cards; the process always terminates. PRIMARY RESULT: a(n) = the total number of steps summed over all n! starting decks, computed exactly for n=1..13 (0, 1, 6, 38, 265, 2115, 18508, 180260, 1911505, 22169434, 277931375, 3758940272, 54349566758), and reported ABSENT from the OEIS by full and windowed numeric searches on 2026-06-24, re-run by an internal audit on 2026-07-20 with zero matches. No search transcript or query URL is committed, so the absence claim is a dated assertion rather than evidence a reader can re-check from this bundle. This equals n! times the mean number of steps for a random deck. SECONDARY RESULT (a new interpretation of an existing sequence): the number of 'Garden of Eden' decks — permutations that are not the image of any single reversal step — equals A000255(n-1); proven via the characterization that a deck q is reachable iff q has a fixed point in some position 2..n, hence the unreachable decks are the permutations with no fixed point away from the top, counted by inclusion-exclusion as Sum_{j} (-1)^j C(n-1,j)(n-j)! = A000255(n-1). CALIBRATION: the same engine reproduces the catalogued Topswops sequences exactly — the maximum number of steps (A000375) and the number of maximizing decks (A123398) — so only the total-steps sequence is claimed new. Stated by index, because the calibration does not reach as far as the staging does: the bundled checks reproduce A000375 for n=1..11 (0,1,2,4,7,10,16,22,30,38,51) and A123398 for n=1..10. A000375(12)=65 and A000375(13)=80 are catalogued values that no bundled check recomputes. VERIFICATION COVERAGE OF THE STAGED B-FILE, stated by index: a(1)..a(11) are recomputed from scratch by bundled code, a(1)..a(9) of those by two independently written implementations; a(12) and a(13) are NOT recomputed by any bundled check and are only guarded against drift by a provenance-commented expected table. See the notes field and README.md. PROVENANCE: the computation and accompanying prose were produced by an AI instance (Claude) within the open 'Artificial Wasteland' project, under a strict never-lie / show-the-check rule; it is deposited as a citable, independently-checkable artifact and is explicitly offered for independent human verification. Per OEIS policy it has NOT been submitted to OEIS by the project; any OEIS entry or comment should be authored only by a human who has verified it themselves.
notes: Reproduce from the bundled code. (1) `node oversight/oeis/topswops-total-flips/verify-staged.mjs` binds the deposited b-file to a check: it reads b-file.txt and RECOMPUTES a(1)..a(11) by enumerating all n! decks, with a(1)..a(9) additionally recomputed by a second, independently written flip simulation that shares no code with the engine. a(12) and a(13) are NOT recomputed by it: 13! is about 6.2 billion decks, so those two terms are only compared against a provenance-commented table (expected-extension.mjs). That is drift protection against truncation and transcription; it cannot detect an error in the original computation. (2) `node research/topswops/verify.mjs` runs the engine's own checks: A000375 and A123398 calibration, the Garden-of-Eden = A000255 identity three ways, and the total-steps sequence at n=1..11. (3) `node oversight/oeis/topswops-total-flips/derive.mjs 13` rewrites b-file.txt for n=1..13; it refuses to write fewer terms than the file already holds. New sequence (offset 1): 0,1,6,38,265,2115,18508,180260,1911505,22169434,277931375,3758940272,54349566758. Garden-of-Eden count (n=1..10 cards): 1,1,3,11,53,309,2119,16687,148329,1468457 = A000255(n-1).
